title: Compact quadratic form composition
objective: Implement exact bigint NUCOMP/NUDUPL-equivalent compact composition and non-materializing specialized quadratic invariant extraction with bounded certificates

oracles: Sage/PARI exact quadratic form composition and class invariants
Magma exact narrow class group invariants

handoff.summary: Adds exact-bigint Shanks NUCOMP/NUDUPL for real quadratic forms, retains product-lattice composition as an independent differential oracle, and replaces eager class-table structure extraction with streamed canonical forms, bounded mixed-radix BSGS, and exact SNF. Ordinary and narrow public class groups now construct invariant factors and generators lazily. Sage/PARI and Magma fixtures cover composition and ordinary/narrow invariants; the benchmark reports compact coefficient growth and retained BSGS size.
risks: The compact engine is intentionally specialized to positive-leading real quadratic forms; imaginary forms continue to use the existing FLINT backend.
The bounded BSGS path fails explicitly when max_bsgs_table is insufficient; it never silently truncates proof data.
architecture:check needs the integration lane to raise the number-field-global-arithmetic byte ratchet from 850000 past the measured 868178 bytes.
next_steps: Raise the shared number-field-global-arithmetic package budget in the integration lane and rerun architecture:check.
Run the exact-head changed/native gates after integration on main.
